raw.details:
Level up from basic LLM wrappers to production-grade AI agents benchmarked against strict engineering rubrics.

Most AI education keeps developers trapped in basic prompt loops and toy wrappers that fail when deployed to real-world environments. HiDevs AI Quest is an intensive technical sprint built exclusively for active builders ready to push beyond simple workflows into high-performance agentic systems. Using Lyzr's agent framework, you will engineer autonomous agents stress-tested and evaluated against strict, quantitative production metrics.

Why You Need to Do This

  • Level Up Your Agent Architecture: Shift from trial-and-error prompting to engineering resilient, multi-step autonomous workflows and agentic governance systems.

  • Master Quantitative Evaluation Rubrics: Instrument your agents to pass rigorous benchmarks across accuracy, grounding, retrieval precision, token budgets, and runtime speed.

  • Log Verifiable Proof-of-Work: Every completed submission is benchmarked, scored, and permanently recorded to your HiDevs Builder Score as a production-grade portfolio artifact.

How This Is Different

  • Evaluation Gates Over Pitch Decks: Projects are judged by quantitative execution metrics rather than subjective slide decks or basic UI wrappers.

  • Exclusively for Active Builders: Zero beginner hand-holding or introductory tutorials; this track is calibrated specifically for developers who have already shipped code and want to build hardened enterprise agents.

  • Native Lyzr Stack: Build directly on Lyzr to deploy deterministic agents with structured outputs, governance controls, and production reliability.

What You Will Do & Rubric Tracks

  • The Lyzr Agent Build: Architect and deploy an autonomous AI agent using Lyzr, optimized across six core production evaluation pillars:

    • Hallucination Mitigation: Eliminate fabricated facts and maintain deterministic output consistency.

    • Groundedness: Ensure tight adherence and verified attribution to source data.

    • Retrieval Quality: Maximize semantic precision, chunk relevance, and context injection efficiency.

    • Costing & Token Optimization: Minimize token consumption overhead and streamline reasoning loops.

    • Prompt Architecture: Engineer robust defensive guardrails and structured system instructions.

    • Latency Optimization: Achieve fast end-to-end execution traces and rapid tool-calling performance.

  • Prizes & Recognition: Top 3 to 5 breakout builds will win from the combined ₹20,000 cash pool and ₹30,000 AI infrastructure credits, with verified builds featured directly to partner networks.

How to Join & Next Steps

  1. Register (Live Aug 27, 10:30 PM): RSVP on Luma to secure your spot and receive HiDevs platform access.

  2. Access Challenge (Aug 31): Get the official Lyzr problem statement, architecture constraints, and evaluation testbeds.

  3. Build & Benchmark (Deadline: Sep 9-27): Develop your agent, run rubric evaluations, and push your repository and live endpoint.

  4. Submission will be started by Sep 9 - 10:00 PM

  5. Submission Deadline - Sep 27 - 10:00 PM

  6. Results Announced (Sep 30): Benchmark scoring completes, Builder Scores update, and the top 3 to 5 winning builds are awarded.

​Format

Online 100% on the HiDevs platform. No travel, no downloads to attend; just log in and start building. Quest tracks stay live on the platform after the kickoff, so you can keep building async at your own pace.

​Where

This is hosted entirely on the HiDevs platform. Your Luma RSVP gets you:

  • Platform access + quest track unlock link (sent before the event)

  • Kickoff walkthrough (Zoom/YouTube Live — link shared closer to the date)

  • Access to the Quest Engine to build, submit, and get scored

AI QUEST : Link
